subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#3 NOT MET — live_preview is dead code. setCommonConfig correctly destructures live_preview and calls addParam, and createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery correctly use rest operators (...commonConfig) to forward it. However, NONE of the public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry) destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. They all use explicit destructuring without a rest operator (e.g., { contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields }) so live_preview is silently dropped at every call site. The setCommonConfig live_preview handling is unreachable dead code — preview context can never flow through to Contentstack queries, directly contradicting AC#3 and prior review feedback: 'query config interfaces lack live_preview fields to forward preview context through to Contentstack queries'.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructuring of each public function and forward it to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. For getEntry: add live_preview to destructuring and pass it in the factory.createContentTypeQuery call. Repeat for getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, and getSingletonEntry. Example for getEntry: `const { contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields, live_preview } = params;` then add `live_preview` to the createContentTypeQuery call object.

issues.description: No test verifies that live_preview context actually flows through a public function (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.) to the Contentstack query's addParam method. The 3 new tests only check the options object and setHost behavior. Since the forwarding code in setCommonConfig is dead code (see blocker above), no test can catch this regression. AC#4 requires tests covering live_preview behavior, and prior review feedback explicitly flagged missing tests. A test that calls getEntry (or similar) with a live_preview parameter and asserts that the mock's addParam method was called with the correct value is required to prove AC#3 is met.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test that calls getEntry (or getSingleEntry) with a live_preview parameter (e.g., { contentTypeUid: 'contentType', lang: ContentstackLocales.EN, live_preview: { enable: true, preview_hash: 'test-hash' } }) and asserts that addParam was called with ('live_preview', 'test-hash').

issues.description: The Contentstack Stack mock does not include an addParam method. The setCommonConfig implementation calls (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash). If the forwarding blocker above is fixed and any test passes live_preview through to setCommonConfig, the test will crash with 'addParam is not a function' because the mock object has no such method.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `addParam: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),` to the jest.mock('contentstack') Stack mock object.

issues.description: Missing tests for setHost fallback behavior. AC#4 requires 3 test scenarios for setHost, but only 1 is present (preview host taking priority). The prior review feedback and learned rules indicate that tests for 'setHost called with CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset' and 'setHost not called when neither host is set' were previously present and were removed. This may decrease the total test count, violating review criteria.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the two missing setHost fallback tests: (1) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset but CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST is set, assert setHost called with API host value; (2) when neither host is set, assert setHost was not called.
